name: Can I apply a new stucco texture over existing stucco?

mainEntity.name: Can I apply a new stucco texture over existing stucco?

acceptedAnswer.text: Yes, in many cases, you can apply a new stucco texture over existing stucco. The feasibility depends on the condition of the current stucco. It must be clean, structurally sound, and free of significant cracks, delamination, or moisture issues. Minor imperfections can be repaired during preparation. If the existing stucco is severely damaged or unstable, it may need to be removed before a new application. We assess the existing surface to recommend the best approach.
acceptedAnswer.description: Yes, you can often apply new stucco texture over existing stucco if it is in good, stable condition. We assess its state to determine feasibility.
